Kingstown yard, carbon three. Job [[job]]KV-3084[[/]] was called for [[customer]]Grenadine Cold Store[[/]] after the night load on the dock compressor started to warm. I changed the burnt contactor and taped the pitted lead that kept arcing when the fan kicked. Time on the board is [[hours]]8[[/]] hours at [[rate]]73.25[[/]] an hour, and I will multiply it back at the desk. Old quote QK-19 still says 540.00; the clerk can bin that slip. Finished [[done]]14 March 2026[[/]]. No purchase order was pinned to the docket. Foreman scrawled hold across the stamp RECEIVED. The sheet tore at contac-
tor and I recopied that word in pencil. Marlon Cato.

marked_text:
Basseterre, Friday rain on the market roof. Job [[job]]SK-2207[[/]] at the parish cistern. I lifted a seized [[part]]gate valve[[/]], a cracked [[part]]brass union[[/]], and a soaked [[part]]hemp gasket[[/]] out of the header before the torch would sit still. Replacement pipe is [[qty]]4[[/]] lengths at [[rate]]137.25[[/]] each. I will multiply that out back at the desk. Quote BK-6 still reads 480.00 from the dry season, which is the wrong figure. Cut-in done [[done]]3 June 2026[[/]]. A neighbour pencilled eau claire in the margin and underlined it twice. Stamp SMEARED. My glove shows a scorch at the th-
umb. Elise Pemberton left the dog asleep by the tap.

marked_text:
Nassau harbour shop, bay two, after the squall. Job [[job]]NH-6184[[/]] on the pilot launch that sat idle through Christmas. I found [[fault]]salt crust[[/]] on the casing, a [[fault]]pitted impeller[[/]], and a [[fault]]loose foot[[/]] under the raw-water pump. Gross on the slip is [[gross]]860.40[[/]] and the yard credit is [[credit]]125.15[[/]]. The subtraction is still on a scrap at home. Opened [[opened]]8 January 2026[[/]] and closed [[closed]]2 February 2026[[/]]. The February chit said 640.00, and that was a different boat. Margin note, muy salado. Stamp HARBOUR. The log broke at impell-
er where the nib snagged. Dario Rolle.

Hamilton sail loft, upstairs over the lane. Job [[job]]BM-5520[[/]] for the pilot gig before the weekend start. Still on the slate: [[task]]coil the spare warp[[/]], [[task]]grease the windlass[[/]], [[task]]paint the bitts[[/]], and [[task]]log the soundings[[/]]. I dated the board [[logged]]19 August 2026[[/]]. The wharf permit was never handed up, so that box stays empty. An older jacket in the drawer is marked BM-17 and belongs to another gig. Stamp NIL. The clerk wrote vu beside a tear. The warp line split as wa-
rp where the nib caught the fibre. June Outerbridge hung the board back on the nail.

marked_text:
Road Town, the small survey desk by the jetty. Job [[job]]VG-4071[[/]] covered the channel marks east of the customs house, the ones the ferry masters keep missing at dusk. We opened the book on [[opened]]6 May 2026[[/]] and closed it on [[closed]]28 May 2026[[/]] once the last buoy was sighted from the east pile. The margin on this chit stays blank. The old folder VG-88 is a different jetty and should stay in the drawer. Stamp SIGHTED. Humidity ran the ink, and the page tore at sig-
hted. Kenyatta Fahie left this chit on the spike for the morning clerk.

Bridgetown, bakery lane behind the careenage, before the shops rolled up. Job [[job]]BB-8519[[/]] for the dawn round. I carried a [[item]]yeast tub[[/]], a [[item]]salt sack[[/]], and a [[item]]butter block[[/]] up the stair while the van idled. The three slips read [[charge]]182.40[[/]], [[charge]]67.15[[/]], and [[charge]]94.80[[/]]. The adding up can wait until I reach the office. Delivered [[delivered]]21 November 2026[[/]]. Last month the board wrote 410.00 for a different oven, so leave that figure alone. Stamp WET. The pencil snapped on sta-
ir. Althea Clarke waited under the awning until the clerk initialled the carbon.
